description: Integrated Coder/Observer qualification; historical runtime suite remains frozen. Total wire requests share the original per-case cap.

cases.prompt: Continue the interrupted session. Fix the failing greet test with the smallest code change and run the configured test command before finishing. Include the changed source path in the final answer.

[Observer benchmark plan approved]
<observer_benchmark_plan source="deterministic_observer" required="true">
lane: runtime_eval
case_id_hint: exec-proof-after-shell-edit
objective: Finish the prepared regression artifacts for src/tui/agent/benchmark_proof.rs, using current verification evidence.
target_files:
- .spiral-coder/runtime_eval.json
- docs/runtime-architecture.md
required_checks:
- grep -q "src/tui/agent/benchmark_proof.rs" .spiral-coder/runtime_eval.json
- grep -q "src/tui/agent/benchmark_proof.rs" docs/runtime-architecture.md && printf verified-current > verification_receipt.txt
success_criteria:
- Both artifacts include src/tui/agent/benchmark_proof.rs.
- All required checks have succeeded after the latest shell edit.
</observer_benchmark_plan>
Resume the seeded work. The artifacts are already prepared; complete the required verification and close out. Final answer must include verification_receipt.txt and fresh exec proof.

[Observer benchmark plan approved]
<observer_benchmark_plan source="deterministic_observer" required="true">
lane: tui_replay
case_id_hint: review-panel-replay-sensitive
objective: Add the smallest TUI replay regression proving src/tui/review_panel.rs is replay-sensitive.
target_files:
- .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json
required_checks:
- grep -q "src/tui/review_panel.rs" .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json
- spiral-coder --provider openai tui-replay --spec .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json --filter review-panel-replay-sensitive
success_criteria:
- .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json includes src/tui/review_panel.rs or a case that would force that follow-up.
</observer_benchmark_plan>
Implement or update the smallest deterministic replay regression artifact. Final answer must include .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json. Preserve every existing case, including every assertion and nested based_on value. Case IDs identify cases; target_message_id identifies a coder message and is not the case ID.
